title: EE-03 TaskStore has zero integration test coverage — all unit tests unconditionally skip
summary: tests/unit/test_tasks_store.zig contains 10 test cases (including TC-EE-03-07, TC-EE-03-08, STC-01 through STC-04) but every single one unconditionally returns error.SkipZigTest. The file's header comment says these are 'stubbed with error.SkipZigTest until TEST-RUNNER executes them against PostgreSQL'. No integration test file covering TaskStore operations (TaskStore.createInTx, TaskStore.list) exists anywhere in tests/integration/. The DB schema, create-in-transaction, and list-with-filters logic for EE-03 tasks are completely untested against a real database.

root_cause.details: Unit test stubs were created as placeholders when TEST-DESIGNER initially wrote the test spec. The intent was to convert them to integration tests, but no subsequent handoff to TEST-DESIGNER created the integration test file. Because unit tests skip silently with exit 0, the gap was invisible.

prevention: Any test file that returns error.SkipZigTest unconditionally for ALL test cases must be treated as a critical coverage gap, not a passing test, and flagged immediately.
Each requirement's acceptance criteria should include 'integration test file exists in tests/integration/ and is wired in main_test.zig' as a mandatory check.
